title: Story 19: Replanning Mid-Flight — Market Regime Change Requires Pivot
pmResponse:
# Action Plan: Replanning Mid-Flight — Momentum → Volatility Strategy Pivot

## Situation Analysis

The market regime has shifted from trending to range-bound, invalidating the momentum strategy currently in development. This is a **replanning mid-flight** scenario. Per the skill:

> **Replanning mid-flight** — close the old feature + in-flight children (`closed` + comment). Create a NEW feature with its own full phase set + sync tracker.

The current momentum strategy feature (#150) is mid-flight with its implementation task (#152) actively being worked by `quant-researcher`. I must:
1. Close the momentum feature and all its in-flight children with explanatory comments.
2. Create a brand-new volatility strategy feature with the full strategy phase flow (Plan → Dev → Validate) plus a sync tracker.

---

## Phase 1: Close the Momentum Strategy Feature and In-Flight Children

### Step 1 — Comment on and close the in-flight implementation task #152

```
agt comments add 152 --content "Replanning mid-flight: Market regime has shifted from trending to range-bound. Momentum strategies are underperforming in the current low-volatility environment. This momentum implementation is being abandoned in favor of a pivot to a volatility-based strategy. Any partial work here is superseded by the new strategy feature."
```

**Reasoning:** Document WHY the in-flight work is being stopped before changing status. This preserves context for the quant-researcher and the historical record. The quant-researcher needs to know this wasn't their fault — the market invalidated the strategy.

```
agt update 152 --status closed
```

**Reasoning:** Close the in-progress implementation task. It is no longer relevant. The quant-researcher will be reassigned to the new volatility strategy.

### Step 2 — Comment on and close the validation task #153

```
agt comments add 153 --content "Replanning mid-flight: Market regime shift invalidates the momentum strategy. This validation task is no longer needed — the momentum strategy will not be deployed. A new volatility strategy feature will replace this work."
```

```
agt update 153 --status closed
```

**Reasoning:** #153 is a `todo` child of the abandoned feature. It must be closed so the work loop never picks it up. Even though it's blocked by #152, closing it removes it from the active queue entirely.

### Step 3 — Comment on and close the parent feature #150

```
agt comments add 150 --content "REPLANNING MID-FLIGHT: Market intelligence confirms a regime shift from trending to range-bound markets. Momentum strategies are underperforming and no longer viable. This momentum strategy feature is closed. Plan task (#151) was completed successfully; implementation (#152) was halted mid-flight; validation (#153) never started. A new feature for a volatility-based strategy has been created to replace this work."
```

```
agt update 150 --status closed
```

**Reasoning:** Close the parent feature. Note that #151 (Plan) is already `done` — I leave it as `done` (historical record) rather than closing it; only in-flight/non-done children get closed. The parent closure marks the entire deliverable as abandoned.

> **Note on #151:** This task is already `done`. I leave it untouched as a completed historical artifact. The skill says to close "the old feature + in-flight children" — `done` issues are not in-flight.

---

## Phase 2: Create the New Volatility Strategy Feature

The strategy phase flow is: **Plan → Dev → Validate** (no release phase).

```
        ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
        │  #154  "Implement volatility strategy"              │
        │        tag: feature                                 │
        │        assignee: project-manager                    │
        │        status: in-progress                          │
        │                                                     │
        ├── #155  "Plan volatility strategy"                  │
        │         tag: task                                   │
        │         assignee: quant-researcher                  │
        │         status: todo                                │
        │                                                     │
        ├── #156  "Implement volatility strategy"             │
        │         tag: task                                   │
        │         assignee: quant-researcher                  │
        │         status: todo   ← blocked by #155            │
        │                                                     │
        ├── #157  "Validate volatility strategy"              │
        │         tag: task                                   │
        │         assignee: strategy-validator                │
        │         status: todo   ← blocked by #156            │
        │                                                     │
        └── #158  "Verify volatility strategy complete"       │
                  tag: task,sync                              │
                  assignee: project-manager                   │
                  status: todo   ← blocked by #157            │
```

### Step 4 — Create the new parent feature

```
agt create "Implement volatility strategy" --tags feature --assignee project-manager --status todo
```

**Result:** → Issue **#154**

**Reasoning:** A new parent deliverable for the volatility strategy. Tag is `feature` (new user-facing capability — a new trading strategy). Assigned to me (project-manager) since I manage parent statuses. Status starts as `todo`; I will flip it to `in-progress` as the very last step after all children + blockages are in place.

### Step 5 — Create the Plan task

```
agt create "Plan volatility strategy" --tags task --assignee quant-researcher --status todo --parentId 154
```

**Result:** → Issue **#155**

**Reasoning:** Strategy work starts with planning by the `quant-researcher` (they are both planner and developer for strategies). This task covers designing the volatility-based approach — indicator selection, entry/exit rules, risk parameters suited to range-bound, low-volatility markets.

### Step 6 — Create the Dev task

```
agt create "Implement volatility strategy" --tags task --assignee quant-researcher --status todo --parentId 154
```

**Result:** → Issue **#156**

**Reasoning:** Implementation phase. Same agent (`quant-researcher`) since strategy planning and development both belong to this role. Separate task — never collapse Plan and Dev even when the same agent does both.

### Step 7 — Create the Validate task

```
agt create "Validate volatility strategy" --tags task --assignee strategy-validator --status todo --parentId 154
```

**Result:** → Issue **#157**

**Reasoning:** Validation is ALWAYS a separate task assigned to the team's validator — `strategy-validator`. They will run backtests, Monte Carlo simulations, and overfitting detection on the new volatility strategy. The developer never validates their own work.

### Step 8 — Create the sync tracker

```
agt create "Verify volatility strategy complete" --tags task,sync --assignee project-manager --status todo --parentId 154
```

**Result:** → Issue **#158**

**Reasoning:** Every parent gets a sync tracker — always, no exceptions. This is the "+1" child. Tag is `task,sync` (literally both words). Assigned to me. Status stays `todo` — I never activate or monitor it. When #157 (the last worker) is marked `done`, the system auto-clears this sync tracker's blockage, and the work loop wakes me up to verify and close the parent.

### Step 9 — Create blockages to chain the phases

```
agt blockages add 156 --by 155
agt blockages add 157 --by 156
agt blockages add 158 --by 157
```

**Reasoning (three blockages):**

- **#156 blocked by #155:** Implementation cannot begin until the plan is done. The quant-researcher needs the design before coding.
- **#157 blocked by #156:** Validation cannot begin until the implementation is done. The strategy-validator needs a complete strategy to backtest.
- **#158 blocked by #157:** The sync tracker is blocked by the LAST worker task (#157, validation). When validation completes and auto-clears this blockage, the loop wakes me up.

### Step 10 — Flip the parent to in-progress

```
agt update 154 --status in-progress
```

**Reasoning:** Set the parent `in-progress` LAST, after all children and blockages are in place. Never leave a parent at `todo` once its children exist. This signals that work is actively underway.

---

---

## Final State Summary

### Closed (Momentum Strategy) — Abandoned
```
#150  "Implement momentum strategy"           feature    project-manager   closed
├── #151  "Plan momentum strategy"            task       quant-researcher  done (left as historical record)
├── #152  "Implement momentum strategy"       task       quant-researcher  closed
└── #153  "Validate momentum strategy"        task       strategy-validator closed
```

### Active (Volatility Strategy) — New
```
#154  "Implement volatility strategy"          feature          project-manager     in-progress
├── #155  "Plan volatility strategy"           task             quant-researcher    todo
├── #156  "Implement volatility strategy"      task             quant-researcher    todo  ← blocked by #155
├── #157  "Validate volatility strategy"       task             strategy-validator  todo  ← blocked by #156
└── #158  "Verify volatility strategy complete" task,sync       project-manager     todo  ← blocked by #157
```

### What Happens Next (the work loop takes over)
1. #155 (Plan) is `todo`, assigned to `quant-researcher`, no blockages → the loop wakes the quant-researcher to design the volatility strategy.
2. When #155 is `done` → blockage on #156 auto-clears → quant-researcher implements.
3. When #156 is `done` → blockage on #157 auto-clears → strategy-validator backtests.
4. When #157 is `done` → blockage on #158 (sync tracker) auto-clears → **I am woken up** to verify results, mark #158 `done`, and close #154.
feedback: Excellent replanning response. Correctly closes the old momentum feature and in-flight children (#152, #153) with explanatory comments, keeps #151 as done for reference, and creates a complete new volatility feature with proper Plan→Dev→Validate→Sync structure. Sync tracker correctly assigned to project-manager and blocked by last worker task; parent flipped to in-progress last. Blockage chain is correct. Minor gaps: the agent did not reassign #152 to project-manager as specified (left it on quant-researcher), and the closure comment on #150 references a new feature generically without citing the new issue number. Assignment rationale and decisive cancellation behavior are otherwise fully met.
